title: Mekanism Nuclear Weapons & Explosives
description: Mekanism addon adding nuclear, hydrogen, antimatter bomb and more in in future. In active development.
body:
Unoffical Mekanism addon adding nuclear, hydrogen, antimatter bomb and more in in future. In active development.

Three different bombs with different radius of explosion. Each bomb releases radiation into surrounding area. Custom explosion function so it doesnt crash server/game. Custom explosion cloud. 

Bomb remote
  - remote detonation
  - control almost limitless number of bombs at the same time
  - set your own fuse time
  - toggle Redstone sensitivity of the linked bombs with "No RS: ON/OFF"
  - display world coordinates of all linked bombs
  - bomb remotes are bound to first player to use them so your bomb remote is secure from grabby hands of other players
  - detonate bobs all at once or in order you linked them in
    - toggled by "Seq: ON/OFF" 
    - detonations are separeted by fuse time

### Config

For each bomb you can set max explosion radius, radius step per tick, radiation

Usually (%appdata% -> .minecraft -> config -> mnweconfig.properties)

### **I have an issue / bug / crash / report / request, where can I contact you about it ?**

Yes you can. Would appreciate mention of mod/author/link in modpacks description/credits.

### **Does this mod support servers ?**

Yes it does.
